verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents per-project alerts that email the project's team members by default, with optional webhook recipients, and teams exist to route error notifications to the right people. That covers basic routing by project to email or webhook, but nothing more of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: environment- and severity-based routing, native Slack and PagerDuty destinations, per-rule thresholds (new-issue, frequency spike, affected-user count), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
